subject.title: [Bug]: macos say command in daemon not output to speakers

question: Should OpenClaw officially support audible macOS speaker playback for Local CLI TTS when the Gateway is launched outside the logged-in GUI session, and should that support be docs-wrapper-only or built into the plugin?
rationale: The current product contract synthesizes an audio artifact through a configured command, while speaker playback from a system-user launchd context crosses macOS GUI-session and daemon security boundaries.

options.title: Document wrapper path
options.body: Use the existing Local CLI `command` and `args` surface to document a UID-safe wrapper and require live macOS proof before recommending it broadly.

options.title: Add plugin-owned helper
options.body: Implement a macOS-specific helper that discovers the active GUI session without hard-coded UIDs and prove it with launchd speaker playback evidence.

options.title: Decline system-user speaker support
options.body: Keep Local CLI TTS as file synthesis only and clarify that system-user speaker playback is outside OpenClaw's supported daemon contract.

recommendation.title: Document wrapper path
recommendation.body: Use the existing Local CLI `command` and `args` surface to document a UID-safe wrapper and require live macOS proof before recommending it broadly.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest combined history signal is Local CLI TTS adoption plus adjacent macOS daemon work.
